signal: Sonatus, the software-defined vehicle company backed by $110M including a Foxconn-led round, continues scaling its AI-powered vehicle software with a growing 270+ headcount.

email.body1:
Walter, been following Sonatus scaling its software-defined vehicle platform on the back of the Foxconn-led round.

Growth that fast usually means more OEM and tier-one accounts in play than the pre-sales and sales bench can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sonatus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Walter, quick follow-up for Sonatus.

In a long-cycle automotive motion, pipeline targets often outrun what the team can cover. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to feed those cycles, so the gap shows up late and the year becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sonatus needs to feed your sales cycles this year, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Walter, last bit of proof for Sonatus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatus' reply rate likely compares to other automotive software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Walter, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling a deep-tech GTM is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an automotive software motion? I'll tailor it to Sonatus either way.
